'''Salis D'aar Academy''' was an educational institution in [[Salis D'aar/Legends|Salis D'aar]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]]. [[Mason Simpson]] was employed there as a mathematics [[Professor/Legends|Professor]].
